title: The 5 Longest Ships Ever Built, Ranked (#1 Isn't a Tanker)

scenes.text: The five longest ships ever built, ranked. Number one isn't a tanker or a cruise ship.

scenes.label: Container ships · 400 m
scenes.text: Number five: the Barzan-class container ships. Four hundred meters long, tied with two other container ship classes.

scenes.label: Esso Atlantic · 406 m
scenes.text: Number four: the supertanker Esso Atlantic. About four hundred and six meters long, and now scrapped.

scenes.label: Batillus class · 414 m
scenes.text: Number three: the Batillus-class supertankers. About four hundred and fourteen meters, a class of four giant oil tankers, all scrapped.

scenes.label: Seawise Giant · 458 m
scenes.text: Number two: the tanker Seawise Giant. About four hundred and fifty-eight meters, later scrapped.

scenes.label: Prelude FLNG · 488 m
scenes.text: Number one: Prelude, a floating gas factory. Four hundred and eighty-eight meters long, moored off Western Australia.

description:
The five longest ships ever built, ranked by length overall.
From container ships to Prelude, a floating gas platform moored off Western Australia.
Which of these would you most like to see in person?
first_comment: Which one would you want to see in person? And what should we rank next?
